sentences.ar: لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ

sentences.note: A preposition 'li-' ('to/for') fused with the attached pronoun 'him'. sentences.note: The prefix says WHO, and the tail ـونَ says THEY. نَحْنُ (we): prefix نَـ — the same ن that starts نَحْنُ — and NO tail: نَقُولُ we say, سَنَقُولُ we will say. هُمْ (they): prefix يَـ PLUS the tail ـونَ: يَقُولُونَ they say, سَيَقُولُونَ they will say. In the past the job moves to the ending: we = ـنَا (قُلْنَا we said), they = ـُوا (قَالُوا they said). One rule saves you every time: the ـونَ tail belongs to the crowd — 'we' never wears it.

sentences.en: THEY say with their mouths (3:167) — يَـ … ـونَ
sentences.note: The prefix says WHO, and the tail ـونَ says THEY. نَحْنُ (we): prefix نَـ — the same ن that starts نَحْنُ — and NO tail: نَقُولُ we say, سَنَقُولُ we will say. هُمْ (they): prefix يَـ PLUS the tail ـونَ: يَقُولُونَ they say, سَيَقُولُونَ they will say. In the past the job moves to the ending: we = ـنَا (قُلْنَا we said), they = ـُوا (قَالُوا they said). One rule saves you every time: the ـونَ tail belongs to the crowd — 'we' never wears it.
sentences.theme: who's doing it — we vs they

sentences.en: There is no doubt in it. (2:2)
sentences.note: لَا + present = doesn't/don't (لَا يَعْلَمُونَ they don't know). مَا + past = didn't (مَا كَانَ he was not). لَمْ + short present = didn't, emphatic (لَمْ يَلِدْ He did not beget). لَنْ + present = will never (لَن تَفْعَلُوا you will never do). When you hear any of these, the sentence flips negative.
